//: Standalone config to TYPE-CHECK and COMPILE the dependency-free core (src/core) plus a runtime verification entrypoint. Used by `npm run verify:core` so the core business logic can be validated and executed WITHOUT installing any npm packages (handy in network-isolated environments). Emits CommonJS so plain Node can run it with extensionless relative imports. The DOM lib supplies web globals (fetch/Response/AbortSignal/crypto/console) that Node also provides at runtime; a small ambient declaration covers `process`.
